items.title: Design reasoning around an inspectable answer
items.subject: reasoning
items.description: Separate answer form, evidence, falsification and acceptance from model confidence.
items.use_when: A target must reason to a supported conclusion or an explicit unresolved question.
items.do_not_use_when: The assignment requires deterministic calculation only, or evidence is missing but certainty is demanded.

items.title: Seven-job schedule with a checkable optimum
items.subject: reasoning
items.description: A real recorded answer reaches makespan 14, with separate feasibility and optimality checks.
items.use_when: Designing inspectable constraint reasoning and independent acceptance; not running this exact benchmark blind.
items.do_not_use_when: Claiming shipped-default stopping, isolated transport, generic refiner success, or independent solving after exposing this answer.
